subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about winning back your lapsed orderers and turning them into validated completed orders. The one point worth repeating: we build audiences from validated order events and optimize to an S2S postback that fires on order_completed with order ID and revenue, deduped against the original purchaser, so you pay only for real reactivated orders rather than re-clicks or app-opens. At scale that lands around 2,500 recovered completed orders a day from dormant and cart-abandoning users. Want me to pull the reactivation-by-metro view for {Brand}?

register_notes: Stage 1 EN US food_and_delivery: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof from parent (validated order events + S2S order_completed postback, pay only for reactivated orders); one illustrative MobUpps figure (2,500 completed orders/day); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; native register; no sign-off; no em dash; no X-not-Y.
